class.name: NNBTRepeater
class.brief_description: Repeats its child node [member repeat_times] times and returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] after the final successful repetition.
class.description:
The repeater node ticks its first enabled child node [member repeat_times] times. It returns [code]RUNNING[/code] while repetitions remain and returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] immediately after the final successful repetition.
If the child returns [code]FAILURE[/code] the repeater immediately returns [code]FAILURE[/code] without counting that tick as a repetition. If the child returns [code]RUNNING[/code] the repeater returns [code]RUNNING[/code] without counting that tick as a repetition either.
If [member repeat_times] is set to [code]-1[/code] the child is ticked indefinitely and the repeater never completes on its own. If [member repeat_times] is set to [code]0[/code] the repeater returns [code]SUCCESS[/code] immediately without ticking its child node.
After the repeater completes, its next tick starts a fresh run according to its reset rule unless that rule prevents it.

method.name: get_times_repeated
method.description: Returns the number of successful repetitions in the current run.

members.member: The number of times this node repeats its child node. [code]-1[/code] repeats indefinitely, [code]0[/code] succeeds immediately without ticking the child.
